items.docs: Retrieve an authorization code to be used in exchange for an access token.

Exchange the authorization code retrieved in the previous call for an access token and a refresh token. 1. Authorization Code
Get an access token and refresh token by calling our /token endpoint and passing through the authorization code from the previous call.
